name: rest_api_server
spec: Create an HTTP REST API server in Python using only the standard library (http.server, json, etc. — no Flask, Django, or FastAPI). The server exposes a CRUD API for managing a collection of items. It should handle routing, request parsing, JSON serialization, basic authentication, and proper HTTP status codes. Data persists in a JSON file.
features: Server starts on a configurable port and logs incoming requests
GET /items returns a JSON array of all items
GET /items/{id} returns a single item by its ID or 404 if not found
POST /items creates a new item from a JSON request body and returns 201 with the created item
PUT /items/{id} updates an existing item and returns the updated item or 404
DELETE /items/{id} deletes an item and returns 204 or 404 if not found
All responses include correct Content-Type: application/json headers
Invalid JSON in request bodies returns 400 Bad Request with an error message
Unsupported methods on valid routes return 405 Method Not Allowed
Basic token authentication via Authorization header — requests without a valid token get 401
Items are stored in a JSON file and loaded on startup
GET /items supports query parameter filtering by any field (e.g. /items?category=books)
Server handles concurrent requests without crashing using threading
